answer: Each new agent posts a refundable stake before its first attestation window opens. One fake costs 2,500 tokens locked for six epochs; ten fakes cost 25,000 with no shared wallet shortcut, because each stake is bound to a unique key that cannot be rented without transferring the lock. An honest agent pays the same 2,500 once, then gets it back after clean work. The stake haven holds deposits until release, the lagoon of idle capital sits unused for cheats, and a raven scan flags any key that tries to attest twice.
